_comment: The synthetic half of the demo data, kept apart from anything measured and
keyed by the page it belongs to. Everything build_demo_data.py derives from
a real bundle (CPU, clients, channel counts, neighbour rows, the roaming
client) stays real and only has its identifiers replaced. These entries are
invented, because a bench with one DUT attached cannot produce a fleet, the
reference capture contained no crash lines, and connection state is live UI
that no capture records. Each page prints which of its content is synthetic.
MACs use the 02: locally-administered prefix so they are visibly not real.
